title: Soul Surfer Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Short walk to Seacrest private beach and lagoon style community pool - Beach tram pickup service available - 2 adult sized beach cruisers included - Garage with extra, full-size refrigerator; complimentary bikes, beach chairs, inflatable paddle boat, fishing poles, beach toys, and other beach gear (stocked garages rare in this neighborhood) - Fully stocked kitchen - Firepit in private side and back yards with tropical foliage and fruit trees. Charcoal grill and grilling area. - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($150 fee applies at booking). See the Gulf and Alys Beach from “Soul Surfer”, on the FRONT ROW of Seacrest Beach, located directly on 30A - quick walk to the beach access and 3 minutes to the largest pool on 30A. 10-foot+ ceilings throughout, tons of natural light and new wood plank tile throughout; recently updated modern décor; 3 dedicated parking spots. Four extra-large bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, private balcony or patio, and sitting area. Accommodations: (sleeps 13) First Floor, Exterior and Stocked Garage: Bedroom 1: Bunk bed (2 full beds with a twin trundle), queen bed and full bath, wall mounted smart TV Outside bedroom: Futon that can be used as a bed if needed, table and chairs in sitting area with TV. 2 sets of double French doors to two separate patios, one with child-proof gate and surround. Access to 18-mile biking/walking path through the towns of 30A from backyard, or very short walk/bike to Seacrest, Rosemary or Alys Beach on this path. Second Floor: Bedroom 2: Master bedroom with king bed, sitting area and large private balcony with full bath accessible to living area, HDTV and large closet (ironing board/iron in this closet). Bedroom 3: Large private master bedroom with king bed, ensuite bathroom with dual sinks, white quartz counters and large walk-in shower. down a spacious hall with French doors to private covered balcony for catching breathtaking sunsets, an unobstructed panoramic view of the Gulf and a view of Alys Beach. Bedroom 4: 2 queen beds, HDTV & DVD, and huge walk-in closet, private full bathroom, private balcony with high railings and a view of Seacrest Beach Resort. ** 2 complimentary bikes with all Sandpiper managed properties, plus use of owner’s personal bikes (quantity varies). ** Complimentary Seacrest Beach Neighborhood Shuttle (March-October). ** No pets allowed ** Renter must be 26+ years; no pets allowed FREE WiFi Amenities Attractions Churches Cinemas Playground Reefs Restaurants General Garage Leisure Activities Beachcombing Outlet shopping Photography Scenic drives Sight seeing Local Services And Businesses ATM/bank Babysitter Fitness center Groceries Hospital Location Type Beach Near The Ocean Outside Balcony Bicycles Deck / Patio Lawn / Garden Outdoor Grill Pool Spa Communal Pool Sports And Adventure Activities Cycling Fishing Freshwater fishing Golf Pier fishing Snorkeling Surfing Swimming Tennis Suitability Children welcome Non smoking only Pets not allowed Theme Family Sports & Activities Safety Outdoor lighting Deadbolt lock on entryway Smoke detectors Carbon monoxide detector Fire extinguisher Emergency phone number: Medical Emergency phone number: Police Emergency phone number: Fire Health And Safety Enhanced cleaning practices Clean with disinfectant No-contact check-in and check-out High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF Kitchen Full Kitchen Refrigerator Coffee Maker Ice Maker Microwave Toaster Cookware Blender Oven Dishwasher Keurig Coffee Maker Living Air Conditioning Ceiling Fans Linens Washer & Dryer Ironing Board Outdoor Deck Patio Balcony BBQ Grill Outdoor Shower Shared Pool Beach Water View Entertainment Cable TV WiFi 2 Bikes Included Smart TV Beach Chairs Provided Beach Town Beach Town -
